summary: Several improvements landed for image decoding, especially around JPEG XL (JXL), a modern image format: Firefox now records decode-speed telemetry for JXL like other formats, adds decoder logging, and recognizes common JXL color spaces using CICP enums (standard color-space identifiers used by codecs) instead of synthesizing an ICC profile. There’s also a small fix in the moz-icon code to strip an unexpected leading period from placeholder filenames so other image code gets a normal name, and a Windows static-analysis cleanup. These changes improve diagnostics and color correctness for newer image formats and make performance and compatibility easier to track.
